description: This file defines the ErrorCode class, which provides a mapping from common spreadsheet error strings to their corresponding error codes within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes a method to retrieve the error code based on a given error string.

classes.name: ErrorCode
classes.description: Contains a static mapping of spreadsheet error strings to their respective error codes and provides a method to retrieve error codes based on error strings.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the error code corresponding to a given error string, or 0 if the error string is not recognized.
